The Land Rover Discovery stands as a premium family sport utility vehicle, balancing authentic capability with flexible interior packaging. Designed for rugged weekend exploration and daily driving, this vehicle boasts a commanding road presence. With spacious seating and an adaptable architecture, it offers a versatile choice for active lifestyles, wrapped in modern British sophistication.

Performance
The advanced powertrain delivers refined acceleration alongside substantial towing capacity for weekend getaways. Power flows through an automatic transmission coupled with a permanent all-wheel-drive system that maximizes traction on slick pavement or loose trails. Electronic air suspension adjusts to optimize aerodynamics on highways and maximize ground clearance over rugged terrain. Drivers can rely on the terrain response system to calibrate engine, chassis, and steering parameters for varying conditions.

Design
The exterior showcases a clean aesthetic characterized by distinctive stepped rooflines and integrated signature lighting elements. Smooth side panels, flush detailing, and an aerodynamic profile provide a tailored look that transitions from mountain trails to city streets. Inside, the spacious layout features high-grade materials and premium accents arranged in an elegant, uncluttered fashion. Seating configurations offer comfort for passengers across all rows, maintaining an atmosphere of crafted refinement.

Technology
A floating touchscreen infotainment hub serves as the center of the dash layout, featuring an intuitive menu interface for media and navigation. The interactive driver instrument display presents customizable travel readouts directly within view, keeping focus on the journey. Device charging, multiple connectivity ports throughout the cabin, and a surround sound system ensure complete entertainment integration. Additionally, an integrated cabin air purification system safeguards passenger health by screening out external particles.

Advanced Safety Features
A suite of driver assistance features monitors surroundings constantly to ensure safety and reassurance. Active lane-keeping assistance provides gentle guidance, while autonomous emergency braking and forward-collision radar help prevent incidents. Parking and trail maneuvers become stress-free thanks to a surround-view camera array that provides visibility around the vehicle footprint. Blind-spot monitoring and rear cross-traffic radar further enhance visual awareness during highway lane changes.

Convenience and Comfort
The cabin offers an adaptable environment featuring power-adjustable leather seating with comprehensive memory, heating, and cooling functions. Climate control systems allow tailored temperature settings for everyone, while a panoramic sunroof fills the space with natural light. Everyday utility is prioritized with smart storage solutions, an available center console cooler compartment, and an inner tailgate design that facilitates easy loading. A convenient power tailgate provides accessibility to the cargo area when managing heavy gear.

This 2025 Kia EV9 GT-Line delivers exceptional capability and comfort for your entire family with a refined three-row design that seats six passengers comfortably.

- Raised Cross Bars
- Brown/Black Two-Tone SynTex Synthetic Leather Seats
- GTL 2nd Row VIP Relaxation Package with Premium Relaxation Comfort Tilt Seat and leg support extension
- 2nd Row 8-Way Power Seats with wing-out headrests
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Integration
- Navigation System
- Heads-Up Display
- 14-Speaker Premium Audio System with SiriusXM
- Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control with Rear Air Conditioning
- Power Moonroof
- 21" Black and Dark Silver Finish Alloy Wheels
- Power Liftgate
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View

As an electric vehicle, the EV9 GT-Line provides impressive efficiency, delivering 88 MPGe in city driving and 72 MPGe on the highway. The single-speed automatic transmission paired with all-wheel drive ensures smooth, responsive handling in any weather condition, while the electric motor delivers consistent performance without shifting or engine vibration.

The VIP Relaxation Package transforms your second-row experience with premium power seating for up to eight-way adjustability. Front passengers enjoy an exclusive premium relaxation comfort tilt seat with dedicated leg support extension, creating a first-class environment for long journeys. The innovative wing-out headrests on all second-row seats add another dimension of comfort when you need it most.

Connectivity and convenience are woven throughout this vehicle. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you seamlessly connected to your smartphone, while the integrated navigation system eliminates guesswork on unfamiliar routes. A heads-up display projects critical information onto your windshield, allowing you to keep your eyes on the road ahead.

Climate control reaches beyond the front seats with rear air conditioning and automatic temperature management throughout the cabin. Heated and ventilated front bucket seats adapt to seasonal changes, and the heated steering wheel provides welcome warmth during cold mornings. The power moonroof bathes the interior in natural light and fresh air.

Safety and security are prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned strategically throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work in concert to keep all six passengers secure, while the exterior parking camera assists with backing maneuvers. The 911 Connect emergency communication system provides an additional layer of protection.

Visit our showroom to experience the EV9 GT-Line firsthand and discover how three-row electric capability can transform your daily driving.

description:
The 2025 Chevrolet Tahoe LT combines capability and comfort in a full-size SUV designed for families and those who demand versatility from their vehicle. With its commanding presence and proven reliability, this Tahoe is ready to serve as your dependable companion for years to come.

- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD for enhanced traction and control across varied terrain
- 17.7" Diagonal Advanced Color LCD Display with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium
- Google Built-in compatibility with navigation system
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM with 360L trial subscription
- Premium audio system with 6-speaker configuration
- Heated and leather-appointed front seats with memory settings
- 8-way power driver and passenger seat adjusters with lumbar support
- Automatic dual-zone climate control with rear air conditioning
- Remote start and remote keyless entry
- Power liftgate and rear window defroster
- Wireless phone charging
- Four-wheel independent suspension with four-wheel disc brakes
- Rear exterior parking camera

This Tahoe delivers a refined driving experience with its smooth ride suspension, speed-sensing steering, and electronic stability control. The spacious interior accommodates up to eight passengers with its third-row split-bench seating, providing flexibility for families or cargo arrangements. Climate control reaches all three rows, ensuring passenger comfort on every journey, whether short trips or extended travel.

The Tahoe prioritizes safety with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an emergency communication system through OnStar and Chevrolet connected services. Front pedestrian and bicyclist braking, traction control, and ABS brakes work together to help you maintain control in demanding situations. The automatic high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers enhance visibility without requiring constant adjustment.

Finished in elegant gray, this Tahoe presents a professional appearance that suits any setting. The 18-inch bright silver painted aluminum wheels complement the exterior while the body-color bumpers and heated power door mirrors reflect attention to detail. The fully automatic headlights and delay-off feature provide convenient lighting control for your daily routine.

Inside, the Tahoe surrounds you with convenient features designed for modern living. Wireless phone charging keeps your devices ready, while the color-keyed carpeted floor mats protect interior surfaces. USB ports throughout the cabin ensure your passengers remain connected. The overhead console, compass, and outside temperature display provide practical information at a glance, while the trip computer helps you track fuel economy and driving efficiency.

With approximately 55,733 miles on the odometer, this lightly-used Tahoe has years of dependable service ahead. The combination of its V8 power, comprehensive feature set, and respected Chevrolet engineering makes this an excellent choice for those seeking a capable family SUV.

The heated steering wheel and door mirrors round out the comprehensive approach to driver and passenger well-being.

Advanced suspension technology keeps this vehicle stable and refined across various road surfaces. The four-wheel independent suspension works in concert with the adaptive air suspension and auto-leveling capabilities to absorb road imperfections while maintaining control. The electric powertrain operates silently, creating a serene cabin environment enhanced by the Bose audio system's 14 speakers and SiriusXM connectivity.

Safety and convenience feature prominently throughout the design. The heads-up display projects vital information directly into your line of sight, reducing driver distraction. Emergency communication through the Volvo Cars App with a four-year subscription provides peace of mind, while comprehensive airbag protection and electronic stability control systems work continuously to maintain vehicle safety.

Come experience this vehicle in person and discover how its blend of electric efficiency, spacious seating, and premium appointments addresses the needs of discerning buyers who refuse to compromise on quality or capability.

- Navigation system with integrated connectivity

- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats

This 2025 Audi Q5 quattro in Gray combines refined German engineering with practical everyday capability. With just 8,532 miles on the odometer, this nearly-new SUV offers the confidence of minimal use paired with comprehensive factory certification. The 2.0L 4-cylinder TFSI engine delivers responsive performance while the available 22 city and 30 highway MPG rating keeps fuel costs reasonable for a vehicle in this class.

- Audi Factory Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle with comprehensive inspection and coverage
- Panoramic sunroof for enhanced cabin light and open-air feel
- Premium leather seating surfaces with heated front seats for comfort
- Convenience Package including heated steering wheel and Top View Camera System
- 19" wheel package with all-season run-flat tires
- Audi Navigation Plus with MMI touchscreen interface
- quattro all-wheel drive for confident handling in all conditions
- Rear backup camera and multiple safety cameras for awareness
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 10-speaker audio system
- Audi Guard all-weather floor mats protecting interior surfaces
- Audi Beam-Rings door lighting with illuminated entry
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Automatic headlights with high-beam assist and fog lights
- Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension

As an Audi Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, this Q5 has undergone a thorough 125+ point inspection ensuring every system meets exacting standards. You'll receive roadside assistance coverage for one year with unlimited miles, a zero-deductible warranty, comprehensive vehicle history documentation, and the certified pre-owned limited warranty that extends coverage for one year or 20,000 miles from your purchase date, whichever occurs first.

Safety is engineered into every detail—from dual front airbags and side impact protection to the security system and panic alarm. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work seamlessly with the four-wheel disc braking system to deliver confident handling in challenging conditions.

Visit our showroom to experience the 2021 BMW X4 M Base firsthand. This is your opportunity to own a vehicle that represents the pinnacle of performance and luxury in the compact performance SUV segment.

Black Raven paint, sculpted Sport styling, signature vertical lighting, and distinctive Cadillac details create an unmistakable presence. Schedule your test drive today and discover why generations of Texas drivers continue to choose the Covert family.

Four-wheel independent suspension with front anti-roll bar provides balanced handling, and the exterior parking camera rear assists with backing maneuvers.

The Navigation System with integrated trip computer helps you plan efficient routes, while the steering wheel-mounted audio and climate controls keep your focus on the road. Rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality adapt to changing conditions without requiring manual adjustment.
